meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: 它接手v1→v2迁移收尾:先确认migrate-v2.sh已运行,否则提示你先运行它。之后做消息收发测试、补owner权限、迁移v1记忆、核对容器配置、处理自定义代码,最后运行verify并重启v2服务。
howto.when: 当用户提到“migrate from v1”“finish migration”“v1 migration”时触发;前提是migrate-v2.sh已运行并生成handoff.json,否则它会先请你运行该脚本。

say.note: 会先检查迁移脚本是否已运行,再接手。

say.text: 完成迁移,先确认v2能收到消息
say.note: 先做冒烟测试,通过才继续下去。

say.text: v1迁移,我想保留自己的自定义改动
say.note: 它会把改动列出来,让你选择处理方式。

howto.what_en: Verifies migrate-v2.sh ran (if not, asks user to run it). Then reads handoff and completes: smoke test, owner role, memory migration, container config reconciliation, v1 fork-code handling. Ends with verify step and v2 restart.
howto.when_en: Triggers on “migrate from v1”, “finish migration”, “v1 migration”. Proceeds only if migrate-v2.sh already ran and handoff.json exists; otherwise tells the user to run that script first.

say_en.text: Migrate from v1 and continue the cleanup.
say_en.note: Checks whether the migration script ran, then takes over.

say_en.text: Finish migration; first confirm v2 can receive messages.
say_en.note: Runs the smoke test before going deeper.

say_en.text: v1 migration — I want to keep my custom changes.
say_en.note: Lists the fork commits and asks how you want to handle them.
